name: Archer
summary: A bow specialist who exchanges bravery, armor training, weapon training, and armor mastery for ranged mastery.

features.name: Hawkeye +1
features.summary: Gain +1 Perception and increase bow range increments by 5 feet.

features.name: Hawkeye +2
features.summary: Gain +2 Perception and increase bow range increments by 10 feet.

features.name: Hawkeye +3
features.summary: Gain +3 Perception and increase bow range increments by 15 feet.

features.name: Hawkeye +4
features.summary: Gain +4 Perception and increase bow range increments by 20 feet.

features.name: Hawkeye +5
features.summary: Gain +5 Perception and increase bow range increments by 25 feet.

features.name: Trick Shot
features.summary: Use a bow within 30 feet to disarm, feint, or sunder at a -4 CMB penalty.

features.name: Trick Shot
features.summary: Learn a second ranged trick shot.

features.name: Greater Trick Shot
features.summary: Learn a third trick; bull rush, grapple, and trip become available.

features.name: Trick Shot
features.summary: Learn a fourth ranged trick shot.

features.name: Expert Archer +1
features.summary: Gain +1 on attack and damage rolls with bows.

features.name: Safe Shot
features.summary: Bow ranged attacks no longer provoke attacks of opportunity.

features.name: Expert Archer +2
features.summary: Gain +2 on attack and damage rolls with bows.

features.name: Evasive Archer +2
features.summary: Gain +2 dodge AC against ranged attacks.

features.name: Expert Archer +3
features.summary: Gain +3 on attack and damage rolls with bows.

features.name: Volley
features.summary: As a full-round action, make one bow attack against every creature in a 15-foot-radius burst.

features.name: Evasive Archer +4
features.summary: Gain +4 dodge AC against ranged attacks.

features.name: Expert Archer +4
features.summary: Gain +4 on attack and damage rolls with bows.

features.name: Ranged Defense
features.summary: Gain DR 5/- against ranged attacks and catch and return arrows as an immediate action.

featureOverrides.summary: Master one type of bow and improve its critical performance.
